📉 "Rates held" was the headline. The minutes tell a different story.

The Bank of England's committee split 6-3 this week — and the three in the minority voted to put rates UP to 4%. Inflation is back at 3.1% and the Bank says it's likely to rise further.

Now look at the calendar: 💡 energy cap up 4% on 1 October → 🏛️ Budget on 28 October that the PM won't rule out tax rises in → 📈 markets expecting a rate rise in November.

Three squeezes on the same wage packet in six weeks — from a government nobody voted for.
